title: Fourteen Autumns and One Short Corridor
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：dormitory　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dormitory 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 my aunt ① moved into a dormitory that no student in the yard would have chosen, and she said the moving was the whole of the autumn. The ② dormitory, meaning the building and not the life, stood fourteen autumns and stayed unnamed in the book; a dormitory, she said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how long it is left unloved.

Every ③ dormitory in that yard had the same short corridor at the end of it, and the ④ dormitory at the end, meaning the one they kept for the new students and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A dormitory, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to live; my aunt said the living is the part that fills fourteen autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dormitory was the whole of the story, meaning the life and not the building. The ⑥ dormitory, meaning the life and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody lives in and nobody calls home; dormitory, he said, is either something you move into or the only word that means both a building and a life. He said the life is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ dormitory had become a line in a roll, and the roll had become an argument about the short corridor. The ⑧ dormitory of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in October, was one yard and fourteen autumns of living; dormitory, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to live. She said the living was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dormitory I remember is the one named in the roll, which closed in 1999 and is still described as the quietest in the yard. A ⑩ dormitory, my mother said in 2001, is the only one that improves by being lived in; every dormitory, she said, is a life that has agreed to look like a building. She said the life was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 宿舍（指那个院子里住着的那一栋）
B. n. 宿舍（指那栋楼本身，与集体生活相对）
C. 固定搭配：move into a dormitory 搬进一间宿舍
D. n. 宿舍（指留给新生住的那栋）
E. n. 宿舍（抽象总称，指一所学校的住宿之事）
F. n. 宿舍（指名册上写到、被列名的那一栋）
G. n. 集体宿舍式的生活（指故事里人人都住、却无人称之为家的那样东西）
H. n. 集体生活（抽象总称，指人人都住、却无人称之为家的那种生活）

items.q: moved into a dormitory that no student in the yard would have chosen
The dormitory, meaning the building and not the life
the dormitory was the whole of the story
the dormitory had become a line in a roll
The dormitory of the whole thing
A dormitory, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: move into a dormitory 意为“搬进一间宿舍”，1978 年姑姑搬进了一间院子里没有一个学生肯选的宿舍。
dormitory 意为“宿舍”，指那栋楼本身而不是集体生活，它立了十四个秋天而在簿子上没有名字。
dormitory 意为“宿舍”，指那个院子里的每一栋宿舍，每一栋到头都有同一条短短的走廊。
dormitory 意为“宿舍”，指留给新生住的那栋，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
dormitory 意为“集体宿舍式的生活”，指故事里人人都住、却无人称之为家的那样东西，叔叔说这种生活就是那个故事的全部。
dormitory 意为“集体生活”，指人人都住、却无人称之为家的那种生活而不是那栋楼，是故事里人人都住、却无人称之为家的东西。
dormitory 意为“宿舍”，指名册上写到、被列名的那一栋，到 1987 年这栋宿舍成了名册里的一行。
dormitory 意为“宿舍”，姑姑十月写道，整件事的住宿之事是一个院子和十四个秋天的居住。
dormitory 意为“宿舍”，我记得的是名册上列名的那一栋，1999 年关了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一栋。
dormitory 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，一栋宿舍是唯一会因为被好好住着而变得更好的地方。
